title: Fix race condition in Manager.Plan()
description: plugin/manager.go: Between releasing the read lock and calling Plan(), another goroutine can Close() and nil the process. Hold RLock through the Plan call using defer m.mu.RUnlock().

title: Fix path traversal in CAS disk store
description: cas/disk/disk.go: blobPath() slices dgst.Hash[:2] without validating length or characters. A crafted hash like '../../../etc/passwd' could escape the blob directory. Validate hash is hex-only and at least 2 chars.

title: Config loading: mu.json + BUILD.json → ProjectConfig
description: Create internal/config/types.go with Go types (ProjectConfig, Target, Service, Trigger, Toolchain, PluginDef, Preprocessor, CacheConfig) with JSON struct tags. Create internal/config/loader.go with project root discovery (walk up from cwd looking for mu.json), JSON loading of mu.json, recursive BUILD.json file discovery and merging into a single ProjectConfig. Create internal/config/validate.go with Go-level validation (required fields, target name patterns, no duplicates). Preprocessor support can wait — this is JSON-native only. See Phase 5 of the plan doc for full type definitions.

title: Replace custom dirOf with filepath.Dir
description: dag/executor.go: Custom dirOf() function reimplements filepath.Dir() without handling edge cases (Windows paths, trailing slashes). Use the stdlib.

title: Replace flag.ExitOnError with ContinueOnError
description: cmd/mu/build.go: flag.NewFlagSet('build', flag.ExitOnError) causes os.Exit() on bad flags, bypassing runBuild's return path. Use flag.ContinueOnError instead and handle the error.

title: Return defensive copy from ArtifactsMap()
description: coordinator/toolchain.go: ArtifactsMap() returns the internal artifacts map directly. Callers can mutate it. Return a defensive copy instead.

title: Remove dead code in TopoSort
description: dag/topo.go: Contains no-op code: inDegree[id] += 0 and _ = dep (unused assignment). Remove dead code.

title: Add Build() integration tests for coordinator
description: coordinator: The core Build() orchestration method has 0 direct tests. Coverage comes only from indirect paths. Add integration tests that exercise the full build pipeline with mock plugins.

title: Complete config validation for all types
description: config/validate.go: Validate() only checks Targets and Services. Plugins, Toolchains, Triggers, CacheConfig, and Preprocessor are unvalidated. Also missing: service dependency validation (Service.DependsOn references other services but no validation those services exist).

title: Coordinator: wire config → plugins → plan → DAG → execute
description: Create internal/coordinator/coordinator.go that orchestrates the full build flow: (1) load ProjectConfig via config loader, (2) start PluginManager with declared plugins, (3) for each requested target + transitive deps, resolve toolchain plugin and send plan request, (4) convert ActionSpecs to Actions via resolver, (5) merge all action subgraphs into global DAG, (6) execute DAG with CAS integration, (7) report results. The coordinator is the central piece that connects config (Phase 5), plugins (Phase 3), and DAG execution (Phase 2).

title: CLI entry point: mu build //target
description: Create cmd/mu/main.go and cmd/mu/build.go implementing the mu build command. Minimal CLI: parse target args, find project root (walk up for mu.json), instantiate coordinator, run build, report results with progress output. Support: mu build //target, mu build //t1 //t2, --jobs N flag, --no-cache flag, --verbose flag. Use minimal CLI parsing (flag package or cobra if needed). Exit codes: 0 success, 1 build failure, 2 config error.

title: Cowsay babashka plugin + example project
description: Create plugins/cowsay/plugin.bb — a babashka plugin that wraps the cowsay command. Discover: name=cowsay, consumes=[source:text], produces=[text_output]. Plan: reads source text file, emits one action that runs 'sh -c cowsay < input > output'. Create an example project in examples/cowsay/ with mu.json, BUILD.json, and a message.txt file. Verify mu build //hello:greeting works end-to-end. Assumes cowsay and bb are on PATH (honor system v1).

title: Replace formatTargets with strings.Join
description: cmd/mu/build.go: formatTargets uses O(n^2) string concatenation. Replace with strings.Join(targets, ' ').

title: Fetch built-in: HTTP download + SHA256 verify + retry
description: Create internal/builtin/fetch.go implementing ForgeFetch: download a URL to a temp file, stream through SHA256 hasher, compare against expected hash, fail with clear error on mismatch (showing expected vs actual). Retry 3 times with exponential backoff on network errors. This is one of the few actions allowed network access. Used by the bootstrap plugin to fetch toolchain archives.

title: Log cache write failures instead of swallowing
description: dag/executor.go: Cache write errors are silently swallowed with no logging. Add at minimum a stderr warning to aid production debugging.

title: Add URL scheme validation in fetch
description: builtin/fetch.go: http.NewRequestWithContext accepts any URL scheme. Should validate HTTPS (or at minimum HTTP/HTTPS only).

title: Add symlink detection in config walker
description: config/loader.go: filepath.Walk follows symlinks, risking infinite loops from cyclic symlinks or config injection from outside project root. Use filepath.WalkDir and check for symlinks.

title: Fix path traversal in resolve.go
description: coordinator/resolve.go: filepath.Join(projectRoot, value) doesn't validate the result stays within projectRoot. A value like '../../../etc/passwd' escapes the project. Validate resolved path has projectRoot as prefix.

title: Add path containment validation in resolve.go
description: coordinator/resolve.go: filepath.Join(projectRoot, value) doesn't validate the result stays within projectRoot. Validate resolved path has projectRoot as prefix after cleaning.

title: Fix nil dereference in Process.Kill()
description: plugin/process.go line 113: p.cmd.Process.Kill() can panic if process already exited. Add nil check: if p.cmd.Process != nil { p.cmd.Process.Kill() }

title: Code review of mu system
description: Perform a comprehensive code review of the mu codebase. Review architecture, code quality, error handling, test coverage, naming conventions, and potential issues. Document findings with actionable recommendations.

title: Toolchain manifest + registry
description: Create internal/coordinator/toolchain.go (or extend coordinator) with ToolchainRegistry: stores toolchain manifests (name → version → artifact paths/digests) after bootstrap actions complete. The coordinator checks the registry before planning non-bootstrap targets and injects toolchain_artifacts into plan requests. Manifests are stored in CAS for persistence across builds. On cache hit, bootstrap is skipped and manifest loaded from CAS.

title: Fix writeFile close error handling
description: dag/executor.go: defer f.Close() after io.Copy means a close error (e.g. disk full on flush) is lost. Close explicitly and check the error.

title: Make topological sort deterministic
description: coordinator/coordinator.go: Map iteration in Go is random. The initial queue of zero-in-degree nodes is populated from a map, producing non-deterministic build ordering. Fix: sort.Strings(queue) on the initial queue.

title: Fix nil ProcessState panic in executor
description: dag/executor.go ~line 169: cmd.ProcessState.ExitCode() panics when cmd.Run() returns error before process starts (e.g. command not found). Guard with nil check: set exitCode=-1, then check if cmd.ProcessState != nil before calling ExitCode().

title: ActionSpec → Action resolver
description: Create internal/coordinator/resolve.go (or similar) that converts plugin ActionSpec output into dag.Action with resolved digests. Steps: (1) hash source files referenced in ActionSpec.Inputs to get cas.Digest values, (2) resolve '{action:id}' references between actions in a subgraph to wire up DependsOn, (3) produce dag.Action with Inputs as map[string]cas.Digest. This is the glue between plugin output (Phase 3) and DAG execution (Phase 2). Needs access to the filesystem to hash source files.

title: Return defensive copy from DiscoverInfo()
description: plugin/manager.go: DiscoverInfo() returns a pointer to internal DiscoverResponse state. Callers can mutate it. Return a copy instead.

title: Bootstrap babashka plugin + example toolchain
description: Create plugins/bootstrap/plugin.bb — a babashka plugin that fetches, verifies, extracts, and registers toolchains. Discover: name=bootstrap, type=bootstrap, consumes=[], produces=[toolchain]. Plan: emits fetch action (uses mu-fetch built-in with URL + SHA256), extract action (tar.gz/zip), verify action (run binary --version), register action (write manifest). Create an example toolchain definition in examples/bootstrap/ that fetches a small tool (e.g., jq or cowsay binary) to prove the flow works. Depends on fetch built-in and toolchain registry.

title: Use defer for file handle in resolve.go
description: coordinator/resolve.go: f.Close() is called explicitly after cas.ComputeDigest(f) but not deferred. If ComputeDigest panics, the handle leaks. Use defer f.Close() immediately after os.Open.

title: Close stdin before killing plugin process
description: plugin/process.go: When context times out, Kill() is called but stdin is not closed first, which could leave the child process in a bad state.
